New Zealand — Super-T 1025 (NZTA RR 364, drawing S1.01, 'TYPICAL UNIT SECTION' 1:20 view, bottom-right of the sheet)

Read the TYPICAL UNIT SECTION drawing (bottom-right). Needed to implement the NZ Super-T: the exact web taper geometry and the dims I could not resolve. Known: overall 2490 wide x 1025 deep; '840' between webs (top); '709' between webs (lower); webs ~100 thick; bottom flange 852 x 240; top slab ~100; tip 75; chamfers 20; a '1:56' slope callout; '67'.
